clues: This town sits far east of Johannesburg. It sits just west of Kruger National Park.
Rain falls here most in summer, but winter brings very little rain. The land turns so dry in winter that forest fires are common then.
The town began after Glynn and Ingle found gold here. They then formed their own gold mining company.
The woods planted around this town form one of the largest man made forests on Earth.
Just out of town, the Lone Creek Falls draw crowds as the most loved sight here. Many other falls splash in and around town too.
